content.short: Fanton is a popular Play-to-Earn fantasy football game integrated into Telegram, using NFT cards of real stars.
content.description: Fanton is a leading Play-to-Earn fantasy football game that operates seamlessly within the Telegram interface on the TON blockchain. Players collect and trade NFT cards of real-world football stars and use them to build teams for various tournaments. These teams compete for rewards based on the actual on-field performance of the players in real matches. By combining the massive popularity of fantasy sports with the benefits of digital ownership, Fanton has created a highly engaging and rewarding experience for football fans worldwide.
content.meta: Play fantasy football and earn rewards with Fanton on TON. Build your dream team on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
content.pageTitle: Fanton - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
